content.heading: Projected Role: Mid-Rotation Starter (No. 3)
content.text: Itoh profiles as a durable mid-rotation starter with upside for No. 2 performance. His 1,000+ career NPB innings, 20 complete games, and consistent 170+ IP seasons demonstrate workhorse durability rare even in MLB. The stylistic comparison to Yu Darvish is apt — both deploy 10+ pitch shapes with elite command from a similar three-quarter slot.

content.heading: Performance Translation
content.text: Applying the 1.096 xFIP− cross-league translation factor (Cho, 2026), Itoh's 2025 SIERA of 2.26 translates to approximately 3.10-3.40 in MLB terms. His career NPB ERA of 2.92 projects to roughly 3.60-3.90 MLB ERA. The historical comp set most closely matching his profile — NPB aces with elite K/BB ratios who transitioned at age 28-30 — includes Iwakuma (3.42 MLB ERA), Tanaka (3.74), and Maeda (3.80). The median outcome for this cohort is an ERA between 3.40 and 3.80 with 115-125 ERA+.

content.heading: Statistical Evidence
content.text: Our stability analysis shows K/BB ratio and BB/9 are among the most stable metrics in NPB-to-MLB transitions. Itoh's elite 2025 K:BB of 6.72 (career 3.68) and 1.3 BB/9 are highly predictive indicators. K/9 and HR/9 translate less reliably. His 2025 K% of 24.5% is above-average but not dominant by NPB standards, suggesting strikeout totals may hold steady or slightly decline rather than spike. HR susceptibility (0.7 HR/9 in 2025, career 0.6) will likely increase 50-80% in MLB given the harder ball and smaller parks, projecting to 1.0-1.2 HR/9.

adjustments.adjustment: Fastball velocity maintenance and usage rate
adjustments.reasoning: At 92-95 mph, Itoh's fastball is average by MLB standards but plays up due to ride and command. He should expect MLB hitters to time the fastball better in repeated matchups through the order. Leaning more heavily on his splitter-slider combination in 2-strike counts — rather than challenging with the fastball in the zone — may be necessary. NPB lineups rarely face a starter for a 3rd time in a game; MLB lineups do, and times-through-the-order penalties are real.

adjustments.adjustment: Pitch mix simplification against aggressive MLB approaches
adjustments.reasoning: Itoh's 10+ pitch shapes are impressive but MLB hitters are excellent at eliminating pitches after seeing them once. He may benefit from narrowing to 5-6 primary weapons per game rather than showing everything. Darvish himself simplified his mix early in his Dodgers tenure. The vertical slider, splitter, and sweeper should form the core secondary mix, with curveball and cutter used situationally.

NPB hitters generally employ a contact-oriented, gap-to-gap approach. MLB's fly-ball revolution means more aggressive uppercut swings targeting elevation. Itoh's 45.7% ground ball rate should be maintained or increased — his sinker and splitter support this. He should avoid leaving fastballs middle-middle, where MLB hitters punish more severely than NPB hitters. Pitch tunneling between the elevated fastball and the splitter below the zone is his best weapon for mitigating hard contact.

section_c.title: Three Priority Information Requests

requests.info: Trackman/HawkEye pitch-level data from NPB (spin rates, movement profiles, release point consistency)
requests.impact: Would allow direct comparison of Itoh's pitch shapes to MLB percentiles. His fastball's induced vertical break is reportedly elite by NPB standards, but without quantified data we cannot assess whether it would rank similarly in MLB. If his IVB is 95th+ percentile NPB, it likely plays at 70th-80th percentile MLB, still above-average. Spin efficiency on the splitter would indicate whether the pitch generates sufficient drop to maintain effectiveness against MLB swing planes. This data could shift our projection ±0.3 ERA.

requests.info: Detailed platoon splits and pitch-type performance vs. LHH vs. RHH
requests.impact: Itoh throws right-handed but bats left, an unusual combination. His vertical slider was specifically developed as a right-handed hitter weapon (.100 BAA, 26.2% SwStr%). If his LHH splits show vulnerability — particularly if lefties can sit on the sweeper/curveball — an MLB team would need to plan bullpen support accordingly. Strong reverse splits (better vs. LHH) would increase his value; pronounced same-side dominance would cap his projection as a 5-6 inning starter.

requests.info: Medical history and biomechanical assessment (especially shoulder and elbow loading)
requests.impact: Itoh has thrown 1,000+ innings in NPB by age 29, with 20 complete games. While durability has been a strength, the cumulative arm stress is significant. A biomechanical workup would assess injury risk. If clean, his innings profile is an asset (he can absorb 180+ MLB innings). If there are red flags — UCL thickness, shoulder impingement history — the contract structure changes from long-term investment to shorter-term bet. This is the single highest-variance piece of information.

section_c.next_step: Recommended next evaluation step: arrange an in-person advance scout visit to Es Con Field for 2-3 consecutive starts, with Trackman data capture. Prioritize a start against a team featuring multiple left-handed hitters in the lineup. Pair the live look with a video review of all 2025-2026 postseason outings, where matchup intensity most closely approximates MLB playoff-caliber at-bats.
